sql: select t.twin_tag, (select count(*) from positions ps where ps.market_ticker in (  select o.market_ticker from live_orders o where o.strategy = t.live_tag and o.created_at >= t.started_at)) as position_rows_scanned, (select count(*) from paper_trades p where p.strategy = t.live_tag and p.legacy = false) as incumbent_trades from live_paper_twins t order by t.started_at desc
